reviewLine: GPT-6 Astra, temporary stand-in for the DwarfHarness advisor Claude Fable 5.1, performed this fresh review and approves Ticket139's complete design as amended in this ruling under D152. Fable remains the main advisor and double-checks the whole ticket after its reset. This is not implementation approval, a contract freeze, runtime evidence or D52 promotion approval.

P1.decision: Add four F3-139 v1 types and schema 5; Defined grows from 49 to 53. Use resource.set, work_domain.set and declaration.set. Leave F3-10 through F3-13 and schemas 1 through 4 unchanged.

P2.decision: External-only registrations are sufficient. ResourceID is an opaque UUIDv7, separate from an explicitly supplied immutable ledger.Resource external address. Preserve existing opaque external-key grammar, including paid-route/<UUID>. Enforce unique address ownership; no normalization, aliases, route lookup, provider functionality or historic registration prerequisite.

P3.decision: Nonempty registered-agent audiences are evidence scope, never authority. Declaration audience is contained in its pinned source and each task audience; each context consumer's agent belongs to the declaration audience. No implicit expansion or disclosure permission.

P4.decision: Expected-zero creation and contiguous CAS revisions; declarations pin the source version current at commit and replace their full consumer set. Empty consumers withdraw edges. IDs are namespaced by kind, not globally exclusive across new kinds.

P5.decision: Task consumers use stable task IDs; context consumers use exact registered bindings. Unassigned and terminal tasks are legitimate evidence consumers. No assignment-following aliases, retirement or deletion API.

P6.decision: Owner-only SetResourceRegistration, SetWorkDomainRegistration and SetDeclaration. No separate register/revise wrappers or Agent methods. Canonical targets are bound once in concrete arguments; remove RegistrationTarget.

P7.decision: One command/effect/receipt Submit; global deduplication before CAS and population guards; original-request preflight binding; actual committed sequence readback and projection installation before acknowledgement; preserve Close, cancellation and poisoning semantics.

P8.decision: Concrete fifth decodeFamily result, three latest-state maps, commandMatch.registration and existing refresh/lookup integration. Shared preflight/replay planner. No independent authority store, history cache, receipt index or generic router.

P9.decision: Frozen 64 KiB payload/submission rules plus only MaxRegistrations=256 and MaxDeclarations=1024 producer defaults. Remove audience/consumer count knobs; preserve bounded allocation and actual encoded-size checks. Replay and matching retries ignore producer population limits.

P10.decision: Owner-only typed current/history/version/receipt queries. ResourceStatus uses exact ledger.Resource plus ThroughSequence. Zero is genesis, ToEnd captures the durable boundary, and future or mid-commit cursors fail. Historical snapshots come from complete validated commits, without a second reducer or cache.

P11.decision: Exactly three slices: contract and freeze prerequisites; complete producer/query/replay with live publication regressions; real interrupted recovery and cross-family acceptance.

P12.decision: Separate D125 freeze, D152 focused evidence/review and D153 final-SHA hosted integration. Require actual Core prerequisite-golden probing before freeze. No duplicate local full gate or routine design confirmation pass.

findings.problem: Bare registration UUID keys exclude the frozen paid-route/<route UUIDv7> grant address.
findings.requiredChange: Persist and canonically bind an explicit immutable F3-11 external Resource, enforce address uniqueness, query by exact address and amend the golden.

findings.problem: S1's blanket exclusion of actual Core probing can freeze invalid earlier-family prerequisites.
findings.requiredChange: Before joint freeze review, run a throwaway real ledgerstore/Core Open probe of the generated golden and a rebuilt invalid-prerequisite control; retain source and outputs privately.

findings.problem: Create/revise wrappers, redundant target representation, cross-kind UUID exclusion and four additional limits add unnecessary surface.
findings.requiredChange: Use three CAS setters and operations, argument-bound targets, kind-scoped IDs and two producer population limits.

sharedFileHooks.ticket140: Primary owns shared history/cache integration. Ticket139 adds no cache or dependency on Ticket140. Preserve whole-commit F0 command-key invalidation; if a cached commandMatch cannot retain registration, leave that positive uncached and use authoritative lookup.

notesForS1: This ruling supersedes conflicting brief text; no routine confirmation pass.
ResourceID and explicit immutable external grant address are separate identities.
Support existing opaque keys, including paid-route/<UUID>, without provider or credential prerequisites.
Use resource.set, work_domain.set and declaration.set; remove RegistrationTarget.
Add only two producer population limits; retain actual encoded-size checks.
Golden has 19 commits and 65 records, an earlier root grant, first new effect/receipt 25/26 and final effect/receipt 64/65.
Run actual Core Open prerequisite probing before the joint freeze review; new-family records may remain unconsumed for that probe.
Record zero reconciliation issues, unchanged durable sequence and ledger bytes; legitimate Completed materialization entries are allowed.
Retain a separate invalid-prerequisite negative control, rebuilt consistently, that actual Core Open rejects.
Generate all hashes; preserve every earlier frozen golden, including D149's corrected F3-13.
Private decisions/evidence remain private under D145; primary allocates record numbers; technical decisions use originator assistant.
No unresolved technical source question remains.
